verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation documents a keyboard-driven launcher: press the Super key and type to search. That covers the launcher half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents broader hotkeys, window-management shortcuts, or operating the whole system without a mouse. missing for 10: documented system-wide keyboard shortcuts/hotkeys, keyboard window management, custom shortcut configuration, evidence that the entire system is keyboard-operable, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power-user, I can operate the entire system using only the keyboard via hotkeys and a launcher

citations.quote: Press the Super key and just type to search for what you need.
